Outdoor amplified music until 10:30 PM; indoor events until 3:00 AM
Outdoor reception can be extended to 11 PM, then an indoor after-party
At least 80% of guests must stay in a room block, minimum 3 nights
715 rooms and suites; group rate needs at least 10 rooms
Packages include coordination; decor, flowers, DJ, lighting, photography quoted separately
Only one wedding per day
Willing to build a proposal for $20,000 and 200 guests but warned it may be challenging
Several indoor and outdoor venues may suit about 200 guests (no number given)

Website check: hilton.com blocks automated reads (403); facts come only from the official page's search-index excerpts, e.g. 'expansive 70,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor event space, perfectly suited for weddings'.
Website check: Not the same property as Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe (Blvd. Kukulcan Km 17). The record correctly points at cunqrhh (CUNQR_WEDDINGS email).
Website check: Some booking sites place it in Puerto Morelos (postal 77569); OpenStreetMap puts the point in Benito Juárez (Cancún), 77580. City kept as Cancún.
Room block offered for June 13-20, 2027 (7 nights)
Sunset View: $273 single per night, $152 per person per night double, child $90, extra person $107 pp/pn
Ocean View: $339 single per night, $188 per person per night double, child $90, extra person $132 pp/pn
No resort fee; group rate 3 days pre/post; free upgrade for the couple; free parking for wedding guests
Room deposit: two nights per room at signing (non-refundable), 50% at 179-91 days, 80% at 90-31 days, 100% 45 days out
Outside vendors may carry a fee
Proposal due date printed as October 16th 2027 (probably means 2026)
Devotion package 2027-2028 (up to 30 guests, Mon-Sun): $8,960; extra adult hotel guest $160, child $80, non-registered guest $185; taxes and service included
Cherish package (up to 30; DJ 4 h, 4-hour reception, dance floor): $15,232; extra adult $180, child $100, non-registered $210
Cherish Captured (adds photography): $17,920; extra adult $220, child $120, non-registered $250
Signature package (Mon-Thu, up to 30, ceremony + cocktail only): $3,640; extra adult $85, child $65, non-registered $150
Package prices include taxes and service charges
Devotion includes a 3-hour private reception with 3-course meal and open bar
Azul Ballroom (up to 1,000) and Hilton Arena (800 banquet) curfew 3:00 am
Lobby Terrace and South Pool curfew 10:30 pm; North Beach 8:00 pm
